title: MariaDB Fresh baseline registration and verify pack use retired split-database physical identities
rootCause: Canonical Fresh uses profile-selected physical cpfDB+mbwDB identities and current OPS_SCHEMA_INSTALLATION, but MariaDB baseline registration still probes/inserts legacy cpf_schema_installation and the verify source hard-codes six retired split database names plus legacy table names. In verifier-owned isolation it can also query an unrelated pre-existing cpfDB, creating a false-green boundary. The canonical vendor generator and profile-aware installer are the repair owners.
repairContract: generate MariaDB verify SQL from canonical logical sections
execute each verify section against its profile-selected physical database
register exactly one baseline row per distinct physical lifecycle owner
use current OPS_SCHEMA_INSTALLATION and current ADM/CMN/MBW table names
preserve seed, engine/collation, transaction-id, stale-table, safety-column and Spring Batch sequence checks

sourceFix.baselineIdentity: one row per distinct profile-resolved physical lifecycle owner
sourceFix.verifyDispatch: canonical logical section to profile-resolved physical database

passCriteria: no hard-coded cpfDB/cmnDB/admDB/batDB/refDB physical connection in current MariaDB verify
isolated randomized physical databases are the only data surfaces queried
baseline rows and identities equal distinct selected physical owners
actual verifier-owned MariaDB Fresh completes all verification
